description: CS102 final roadmap: classes, interfaces, inheritance and polymorphism, generics and collections, files, linked lists, recursion and 2D arrays, with the material to study for each topic, look-alikes and a coverage tracker.
lede: CS102 builds object-oriented Java in layers: design a class, connect classes through interfaces and inheritance, write code that works for any type with generics and collections, then build your own structures and recursive solutions.
